channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: Hormel announces definitive agreement to sell its whole-bird turkey business
item.description: Hormel Foods will sell its whole-bird turkey business, including the Melrose plant, Swanville feed mill and transport assets, to Life-Science Innovations by end of Q2 2026; JENNIE-O stays.

item.title: Austin’s new housing code inspector position is about being proactive
item.description: Austin’s new housing code inspector role focuses on proactively spotting aging home issues and connecting residents with repair and financing resources to prevent deterioration, not punish owners.

item.title: Packer seniors say goodbye to Ove after loss to Century
item.description: Austin seniors Chloe Cannon and Gracie Arndt bid emotional farewell to Ove Berven Gym as Packers show strides in 73-58 loss to Century and Arndt caps a record rebounding season.

item.title: Hayfield boys can't complete comeback against Randolph
item.description: Hayfield boys fall 66-60 at Randolph despite erasing 15-point deficit with 16-0 run, led by Charlie Walker’s 27 points.

item.title: Staloch leads BP boys past Knights
item.description: Gabe Staloch scores 27 as Blooming Prairie routs Kenyon-Wanamingo 84-51, improving to 18-8 overall.

item.title: Lyle-Pacelli boys storm past Cardinals
item.description: Lyle-Pacelli capped its regular season with an 86-45 road win at LeRoy-Ostrander, led by 19 points from Alex Lagunas and 18 from Casimir Assogba.

item.title: Rebel boys win 19th straight game
item.description: Southland boys basketball stretched its winning streak to 19 with an 80-62 road win over Spring Grove, as Henry Wiste scored 24 points to push the Rebels to 24-1 overall.

item.title: Bruins fall short in shootout
item.description: Austin Bruins rally to tie on Sam Kline’s third-period goal but fall 3-2 in a shootout to the St. Cloud Norsemen on the road.

item.title: Panthers take down Austin boys basketball team
item.description: Austin boys basketball falls 72-64 at Rochester Century; Cole Hebrink scores 23 points in the loss.

item.title: Dahl sets two AHS swim records, Packers advance four to state
item.description: Austin's Brent Dahl breaks two school records and posts an All-American backstroke time as he and three Packers teammates qualify for the boys state swim meet.
